stem:
A reaction sequence based on propan-1-ol is shown.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Reactions 1 and 2 can both be carried out using the same reagents.
parts.text: Identify suitable reagents for reactions 1 and 2.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain how the reaction should be carried out to ensure that reaction 2 rather than reaction 1 occurs.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify the necessary reagents and conditions for each of reactions 3 and 4.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Complete the reaction mechanism for reaction 5. Include all relevant lone pairs, curly arrows, charges and partial charges.

{{figure:figure_5_2.png}}

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.stem: The product of reaction 5 exhibits stereoisomerism.
parts.text:
Draw the two stereoisomers in the conventional way.

{{figure:figure_5_3.png}}

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why a mixture of the two stereoisomers is formed by reaction 5.
